turns.prompt: when I end a meeting, the recap leaves out any task that has a person on it but no deadline. like if they say 'Priya will send the contract' with no date it just isnt in the action items. can you fix it
turns.final_message:
I fixed it. The model was returning the task, and the app was dropping it afterward.

**Cause:** After the summary came back, `electron/MeetingPersistence.ts` ran every action item through a regex. It only kept items containing a word like "by", "due", "on", "next" or a weekday, or any digit. "Priya will send the contract" has none of those, so it was silently removed. That also made it inconsistent: "Priya will send 2 contracts" would have passed just because it has a digit.

**Changes, all in `electron/MeetingPersistence.ts`:**
- **Filter removed (line 235).** Every action item is kept now. The only things still dropped are empty or non-text entries, so a bad model response can't break the recap.
- **Prompt updated.** The default summary prompt now asks for items in an "Owner: task" format, adds a due date only when one was said, and tells the model to keep owner-only tasks. That matches the rule already in `electron/llm/prompts.ts`.

**Not tested:** I couldn't type-check or run it. There's no `node_modules` in this copy, and the sandbox blocked npm from downloading TypeScript. To check it, run `npm install && npx tsc --noEmit -p electron`, then end a test meeting where someone says something like "Priya will send the contract" with no date.

The mode-specific recaps (Team Meet and the other templates) never went through that filter, so they weren't affected.

The first fix only covered half the problem. The app no longer deletes those tasks, but the prompts still led the model to skip them when it wrote the recap. I fixed that side now. I still can't build or run it here because there's no `node_modules` and npm is blocked, so none of this is tested.

**Why Priya's task was still missing:**
- **Team Meet mode.** The default instruction for its "Action Items" section was "All action items that were said **I** would do after the meeting." A task Priya owns doesn't count under that, so the model left it out. If you record meetings in Team Meet mode, this was almost certainly the cause.
- **The other model's prompt.** The recap is sometimes written by a second AI service (Groq), which has its own prompt. Its only example action item had a date ("Bob: Draft invite copy by Wednesday"), which pushes the model toward dated tasks.
- **Shared rules.** Nothing in the rules both recap types use said that an assigned task with no date still counts.

**What I changed:**
- `electron/MeetingPersistence.ts`: added two rules every recap uses. A task assigned to a person is an action item even with no date, and action items include anyone's tasks, not just yours.
- `electron/llm/prompts.ts`: the Groq prompt now has an example with no date ("Priya: Send the contract (no date given)") and says to include every assigned task.
- `electron/services/ModesManager.ts` and `electron/db/DatabaseManager.ts`: the default Team Meet "Action Items" text now asks for every task assigned to anyone, with the date only if one was given.

**Your existing Team Meet mode won't pick this up.** A mode that already exists keeps the old "I would do" text saved in its settings. Either edit that section's description in the mode settings, or I can add a one-time migration that updates the old default text automatically. The Sales and Recruiting modes have the same "only my items" wording, but I left those alone since that may be what you want there.

To test it, run `npm install`, then record a short meeting in the mode you normally use where someone says "Priya will send the contract" with no date. It should show up as "Priya: Send the contract".

I found two more places where tasks get lost, but I'm guessing at which one you're hitting. I've traced every step from the end of a meeting to the recap screen, and no other code removes action items. What's left is the model never seeing the line, or seeing it and leaving it out. Still not built or run here, same reason as before (no `node_modules`, npm blocked).

**Fixed this round:**
- **The end of longer meetings was cut off.** `electron/MeetingPersistence.ts` sent only the first 10,000 characters of the transcript to the model, which is roughly the first 10 to 15 minutes. Tasks usually get handed out at the end ("ok, Priya will send the contract"), so in any longer meeting the model never saw them. It now sends up to 40,000 characters, and if a meeting is longer than that it keeps the opening and the last part, never cutting the end.
- **Very long meetings compress their early part.** `electron/SessionTracker.ts` summarizes the oldest part of the transcript once it gets very long, and that summary only kept topics, decisions and questions. It now also lists every assigned task, with or without a date.

**Still possible after this:**
- **Old Team Meet text.** If you record in Team Meet (or a custom mode) created before my last change, its Action Items section still says "things I would do", which excludes Priya's tasks. It needs to be edited in that mode's settings, or I can write a migration that updates it.
- **Separate bug I noticed, not fixed.** The Groq prompt asks for a `summary` key, but the app reads `overview`. When Groq writes the recap, the overview comes up blank. Action items are unaffected.

To pin it down, I need two things from one meeting where it failed: which mode you were in, and the console line that starts with `[MeetingPersistence] Raw LLM summary response`. That line shows exactly what the model returned. If Priya's task is in it, the problem is on the display side. If it isn't, it's the prompt or the transcript.
